correctness.rationale: Proof reduces IR coalitions to independent sets, then applies a valid convex majorization bound on all positive-product sizes, constructs an attaining (k,k-1,2) partition for every odd cycle n>=7, and counts all optimizers with explicit k=3 double-count correction. The n=3,5 zero boundary follows from nonbipartiteness and coalition-size lower bounds. Independent C++ and Python exact enumerations reproduce products/counts through 13/11 vertices respectively. Finite data are support, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete exact classification of the canonical sparse nonbipartite enemy graph family resolves both welfare magnitude and multiplicity, with a sharp distinction between C5 (3-colorable but zero Nash welfare) and C7 (positive), and an explicit linear-time construction of maximizers. The full optimizer count grows quadratically in odd cycle size, a structural conclusion unavailable from the general existence/hardness results. This is an intrinsic exact extremal problem, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
